atoms.proposition: the donor is an individual who donates to a charity or CASC
the donor has paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in that tax year as the amount of Gift Aid claimed
the donor has made a Gift Aid declaration that gives permission to claim Gift Aid on the donation
the donation is not made through Payroll Giving
the donation is not a payment for goods or services or made because the charity bought goods and services
the donation does not give the donor a 'benefit' over a certain limit
the donation is not of shares or any other form of securities
the donation is not from a charity card or voucher, such as Charities Aid Foundation (CAF) vouchers
the charity is recognised as a charity or CASC for tax purposes

decision_target: eligibility for Gift Aid on a donation
limitations: The policy does not specify how to evaluate whether a donation constitutes a 'benefit' over a certain limit, leaving this condition under-defined.

The policy does not specify whether a donation grouped with CAF card or voucher redemptions in a batch constitutes a separate donation for Gift Aid purposes, though it notes the batch was made on a different date.
scope_issues: The policy applies to donations from individuals, but does not specify whether the same rule applies to all types of donations (e.g., one-off vs. recurring), nor whether the rules are cumulative across multiple donations.
